subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread opt-in be modeled as a new `dmThreadMode` account key, or should it extend the existing `replyToMode` threading configuration instead?
rationale: Both shapes are technically plausible, but config surface is user-facing and compatibility-sensitive; automation cannot decide whether maintainers want a second Google Chat threading knob.

options.title: Use the existing threading config family
options.body: Model the DM opt-in through `replyToMode` or a narrow extension of that existing threading API, then update the implementation and docs around one threading contract.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` as a separate key
options.body: Keep the PR direction, but require exported types, generated metadata, docs/help, focused tests, and real Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Pause or close this direction
options.body: If Google Chat DMs should remain unthreaded because the API rejects thread reply options there, close or pause this PR until a stronger API-backed design is available.

recommendation.title: Use the existing threading config family
recommendation.body: Model the DM opt-in through `replyToMode` or a narrow extension of that existing threading API, then update the implementation and docs around one threading contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current DM-thread suppression behavior and maintainer verification for the prior fix, so they are the best available routing candidate for the product/API choice.
